page_title: NIC 1-0 TOU | Nice v Toulouse 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Francois Letexier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+2' A dangerous looking corner kick from Morgan Sanson (Nice) is cleared to safety by the defence.

90+2' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vincent Sierro walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Marcin Bulka has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
89' Frank Magri (Toulouse) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
87' A quickly taken corner by Nice.
86' A pass lands at the feet of Evann Guessand (Nice) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Terem Moffi leaves the pitch and Antoine Mendy (Nice) comes on.
83' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
82' Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
81' Mamady Bangre (Toulouse) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
81' What a great touch by Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
79' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Gabriel Suazo is replaced by Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse).
79' That's the end of the game for Aron Donnum, who is replaced by Mamady Bangre (Toulouse).
78' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Romain Perraud (Nice) but poses no threat.
76' It looks like Aron Donnum (Toulouse) saw red with that tackle. Francois Letexier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
73' Logan Costa (Toulouse) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
72' The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.
72' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Jordan Lotomba and he is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Romain Perraud (Nice) for Jeremie Boga.
72' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
65' Gaetan Laborde goes off the pitch and Evann Guessand (Nice) comes on.
65' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) replacing Cristian Casseres.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Kamanzi departs the field of play to be replaced by Moussa Diarra (Toulouse).
62' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
61' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
60' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Guillaume Restes.
58' 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
54' 1 - 0 Terem Moffi (Nice) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
52' Referee Francois Letexier sees the trip by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
49' Terem Moffi (Nice) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
48' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) replaces Sofiane Diop.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
45+1' Melvin Bard (Nice) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Melvin Bard (Nice) is able to continue to play.
44' Morgan Sanson (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guillaume Restes intercepts the ball.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jeremie Boga (Nice).
42' Melvin Bard (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

42' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
41' Terem Moffi (Nice) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
39' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
39' Jeremie Boga (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
38' Logan Costa (Toulouse) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Francois Letexier signals.
37' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
35' Frank Magri (Toulouse) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
35' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. It's a throw-in for Nice.
34' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) for his blatant foul.
32' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
29' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
28' The game is interrupted now, Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
23' Morgan Sanson (Nice) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
22' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
22' Francois Letexier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
21' Rough tackle by Morgan Sanson (Nice). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Shots on target – 0:0.
17' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
16' Poor challenge! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is penalised for tripping and Francois Letexier blows his whistle.
13' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball has crossed the sideline. Toulouse are taking a throw-in.
13' The free kick from long range, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

11' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francois Letexier with no other option than to blow for a foul.
11' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
9' Khephren Thuram (Nice) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Toulouse.
8' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
7' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
7' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) brings his opponent down. Francois Letexier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Dante (Nice) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
4' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' The Frank Magri (Toulouse) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Francois Letexier rules it out for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Toulouse will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier will supervise the game today.
